idea-plugin.name: DuckDB (Brikk)
idea-plugin.description:
A dedicated DuckDB experience for DataGrip and IntelliJ-family IDEs: a real DuckDB (Brikk) SQL dialect (Postgres-based, matching DuckDB's own parser lineage) and ready-to-use data-source templates for local DuckDB and GizmoSQL servers (Arrow-free quack-jdbc driver).

Early stage. The stock IDE treats DuckDB as a generic data source with the Generic SQL dialect; this plugin exists to give DuckDB SQL first-class treatment — SELECT * EXCLUDE(...), QUALIFY, GROUP BY ALL, lambdas, PIVOT, FROM-first queries — using the architecture proven by the SQL Dialect for Apache Doris plugin.

This is an independent, community plugin developed by Sortdev SRL, not affiliated with DuckDB Labs, the DuckDB Foundation, or GizmoSQL. "DuckDB" is a trademark of the DuckDB Foundation, used only to identify the database this plugin supports.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — first public preview.
  • DuckDB dialect with correct statement/run-block boundaries across the DuckDB statement surface — SELECT * EXCLUDE(...), QUALIFY, GROUP BY ALL, struct/list literals, lambdas, PIVOT/UNPIVOT, FROM-first queries, ATTACH, SUMMARIZE, CREATE MACRO/SECRET and more. Coverage is measured against DuckDB's own test suite: 226/226 sampled syntax families parse clean at DuckDB 1.5.5.
  • Engine-exact error checking: statements are validated by a real DuckDB (found on your data source's driver; EXPLAIN-based, never executes) — squiggles carry the engine's own parser messages.
  • Function completion: 943 built-ins with kind icons (scalar / aggregate / table / macro), harvested from duckdb_functions() itself.
  • Ready-made data sources: local DuckDB and GizmoSQL servers (token-auth quack-jdbc, port 9494); driver versions pinned and auto-downloaded from Maven Central, matched to the tested engine version.
